scope.description: Refresh the existing QinetiQ Target Systems Canada record with concrete aerial and naval target technologies, current official activity, Canadian identity and contact context, and the live naval-target standing offer.

source.title: Mission Rehearsal and Operational Readiness — Target Services
source.summary: QinetiQ identifies Alberta, Canada as a target-system manufacturing location and documents aerial, rotary-wing, land, naval and special-mission targets, command and control, scoring, launchers and field services.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official target-services portfolio and product pages; 2026 Hammerhead field deployment; current CanadaBuys standing-offer and company profile records
followUpQuestions: Confirm the current Ontario legal entity name before changing the canonical legalName field.
reviewWarnings: Corporations Canada shows the former federal QinetiQ Target Systems Canada Inc. as discontinued to Ontario; the current CanadaBuys history uses QinetiQ Group Canada Inc. Contracting and operating aliases are retained in profile context, but legalName is deliberately left unchanged pending Ontario-registry confirmation.
leads.refreshSummary: Add separately reviewable Banshee aerial and Hammerhead/Barracuda naval target capabilities, enrich the company profile with Canadian operating context and current activity, and add its live naval-target standing-offer program.
intendedChanges: Add the Banshee aerial target systems capability.
Add the Hammerhead and Barracuda uncrewed naval target systems capability.
Enrich profile data while preserving existing review metadata.
Add the Canadian naval-target standing-offer program participation.
